name: pkg_installed
description: List installed packages per manager (dpkg/rpm, pip, npm global+project, go.mod); listing only

manager.description: which manager to list (default auto: every one available; npm = global and project)

name.description: case-insensitive substring filter on the package name

limit.description: packages to return, sorted by manager/name (default 300)

path.description: project directory for node_modules and go.mod/go.sum (default: project root)
